'''Usilic''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Kor Usilic]], which was located in the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], was the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the Usilic kajidic.<ref name="TEA Kor Usilic" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Usilic kajidic was introduced via mention of Kor Usilic in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TEA" />
